timing_and_agency.baseline: At 1283-09-27 14:39 ~8h after bond, progression remains stage0 below threshold8, no outward effects beyond seal, bare contact safe. As of same day no perfume-inspired pact scent has appeared.
timing_and_agency.manifestation: Crossings represent physiological changes manifesting gradually during normal scene play; don't narrate cosmetic metamorphosis instantly within a single combat cast even when points cross threshold. For visible description spread the transition across subsequent hours/days consistent with elapsed time, but contact hazard not active before threshold78 AND stage5 is narratively and physically established.
timing_and_agency.medical: User's elite control 5/5 and Zero Genome can detect and compensate acute physiological disturbances and safely modify his own tissue where learned, but CANNOT simply erase external permanent covenant or lower counter through routine DNA edits. No assumed voluntary countermeasures unless user requests.
timing_and_agency.learning: Neither school has any learned combat technique at baseline. Opening contract alone doesn't grant forbidden formulas; attempt/practice/mastery/cast events apply only to established actual learning/usage in scenes, never retroactively.
timing_and_agency.skin_route: After stage5: only direct BARE living skin-to-skin exposure. Any intact cloth, gloves, bandage, sheet, tool or barrier COMPLETELY blocks it. No blood/object fomite, airborne, proximity, indirect propagation, stored contagious tools, epidemics. No automatic infection before stage5.
excluded: No abnormal warm skin, fever, altered taste or pain reduction as background pact side effects. Unusual scent APPROVED 2026-11-15 and staged separately
No reduction of battle movement, medical skill, intelligence, stamina stats solely because of gaunt appearance
Never place tattoo roots onto Shiki's face
timing_and_agency.privacy: GM-internal numeric value and exact thresholds stay hidden unless Shiki derives evidence through actual diagnostics. Player may request OOC counter status from GM.

idempotency: Every added event must have a stable unique event_id and recorded at; repeated same event_id has NO additional cost; mastery once per distinct acquired technique id.
version_note: User's later explicit requests take precedence. If scene contradicts model, direct canon/played events outrank this rules draft; do not invent actual practice.
